t: What an open-air test bench is
title: Benchtop Open-Air Test Bench — What an open-air test bench is
description: An open-air test bench is a modular frame that holds a motherboard, PSU, GPU, and drives with no case panels around them. Reviewers and overclockers build on benches because every component stays reachable and every temperature stays honest.

t: Why benches beat cases for testing
title: Benchtop Open-Air Test Bench — Why benches beat cases for testing
description: Swapping a GPU on a bench takes a minute; in a case it takes fifteen, with cable origami each way. For testing many parts in one day, the bench pays for itself in saved time before lunch.
